items.title: 71542_Bill Coleman autobiographical manuscript
items.q: I was not real happy about the deal, although I liked Face, as he was called by everyone that knew him well. I was certain that he would be a very disagreeable person to get along with when it came to working with him. But we were stuck and needed a drummer, so that was that!

ctx.x: I played 21 cities with Fred Bunge in Germany. Sometimes, we did two concerts a day but in different towns. The last one was Wuppertal the 2nd of October, and I came back to Paris the next day. I enjoyed playing with Fred Bunge and his band and they told me that they had been very pleased to have worked with me.

During my stay in Germany, Lily had sent me a letter, saying that she had engaged Zutty Singleton to make the tour with me, that she was organizing. I was not real happy about the deal, although I liked Face, as he was called by everyone that knew him well. I was certain that he would be a very disagreeable person to get along with when it came to working with him. But we were stuck and needed a drummer, so that was that!

Later, while still in Germany Lily wrote me and said that she had received a notice that Jimmie "Slim" Rodgers had died suddenly. Se had heard about a young Canadian Negro pianist that was playing in a club in Paris and asked Zutty and his wife Margie to come with her to hear this pianist and let her know if he thought the fellow was good and would be alright for our band.
